adapters.enumeration_strategy: enumerate scripts, policies, UTXOs, datums, redeemers and transaction constraints
adapters.authority_model: signatories, script context, minting policy and input ownership
adapters.state_model: UTXO set, datum, value bundles, reference inputs and validity intervals
adapters.trace_strategy: ledger emulator transaction trace with complete body and resulting UTXO set
adapters.simulation_strategy: ledger emulator or isolated testnet fixture
adapters.property_strategy: value conservation, policy authority, replay and datum authenticity properties
adapters.reproduction_format: transaction body, inputs, outputs, datum, redeemer, policy and resulting UTXO set
known_gaps: no bundled native parser or emulator
provider/indexer semantics require external validation

adapters.enumeration_strategy: enumerate contracts, instantiate/execute/query/migrate messages and IBC handlers
adapters.authority_model: sender, admin, contract callbacks, capabilities and IBC channel authority
adapters.state_model: contract storage, bank/CW assets, reply state and IBC packet lifecycle
adapters.trace_strategy: native app/wasm event and submessage/reply trace
adapters.simulation_strategy: multi-test, local chain or isolated testnet
adapters.property_strategy: fund conservation, reply ordering, migration and IBC replay properties
adapters.reproduction_format: messages, funds, height/time, events and storage/state diff
known_gaps: no bundled native parser or simulator
module and relayer behavior is harness-dependent

adapters.enumeration_strategy: enumerate source/ABI/bytecode, entry points, storage layout, proxies and deployment metadata
adapters.authority_model: msg.sender/value, signatures, roles, owners, proxy admins and timelocks
adapters.state_model: storage slots, balances, allowances, indexes, checkpoints, prices and proxy state
adapters.trace_strategy: compiler-pinned call trace, logs and state diff at a bound chain/block
adapters.simulation_strategy: unit test, local deployment or pinned fork
adapters.property_strategy: stateful invariants for authorization, conservation, solvency, units and ordering
adapters.reproduction_format: compiler/config, chain/block, fixture state, transaction sequence, trace and state diff
known_gaps: no bundled compiler/parser/fork
EVM variants require separate semantic validation

adapters.enumeration_strategy: enumerate packages, modules, public entry functions, abilities, resources and objects
adapters.authority_model: signers, capabilities, object ownership and module visibility
adapters.state_model: resources, objects, tables, global storage and event state
adapters.trace_strategy: native transaction trace and resource/object change set
adapters.simulation_strategy: native test runner, local validator or sandbox
adapters.property_strategy: resource conservation, capability scope, object ownership and abort-path properties
adapters.reproduction_format: package/version, signer set, transaction sequence and resource change set
known_gaps: Aptos/Sui dialect differences require native specialization
no bundled Move toolchain

adapters.enumeration_strategy: enumerate contracts, methods, access keys, promises, callbacks and storage prefixes
adapters.authority_model: predecessor/signer, access-key permissions and callback provenance
adapters.state_model: contract storage, deposits, promises, receipts and async reconciliation
adapters.trace_strategy: transaction plus complete receipt/callback chain and state changes
adapters.property_strategy: deposit conservation, callback authentication, retry and async finality properties
adapters.reproduction_format: account/key context, calls, attached deposit, receipts and final state
known_gaps: no bundled sandbox
cross-contract receipt/indexer completeness depends on provider

adapters.enumeration_strategy: enumerate programs, IDL/instructions, account metas, PDAs, owners and token programs
adapters.authority_model: signer/writable flags, owners, PDA seeds, CPI privilege and upgrade authority
adapters.state_model: accounts, lamports/tokens, account data, sysvars and transaction ordering
adapters.trace_strategy: instruction/CPI logs with pre/post account snapshots
adapters.property_strategy: account constraint, conservation, aliasing, CPI target and lifecycle properties
adapters.reproduction_format: program/version, account metas/data, instruction sequence, logs and post-state
known_gaps: no bundled IDL parser or validator
token extensions and runtime versions require pinning

adapters.enumeration_strategy: enumerate classes/contracts, entry points, storage, dispatch and upgrade paths
adapters.authority_model: caller address, account abstraction, signatures and class/upgrade authority
adapters.state_model: storage, nonces, class hashes, messages and L1/L2 state
adapters.trace_strategy: native call trace, events, messages and storage diff
adapters.simulation_strategy: native test framework, devnet or isolated testnet
adapters.property_strategy: felt/range, authorization, replay, messaging and upgrade properties
adapters.reproduction_format: compiler/class hashes, network/block, calls, trace and storage diff
known_gaps: no bundled Cairo compiler/devnet
L1 messaging finality needs external evidence

adapters.enumeration_strategy: enumerate pallets, calls, origins, storage, hooks, migrations and runtime upgrades
adapters.state_model: runtime storage, balances/assets, queues, hooks and versioned migrations
adapters.trace_strategy: extrinsic/events/storage diff bound to runtime metadata and block
adapters.simulation_strategy: try-runtime, native tests, local node or isolated testnet
adapters.property_strategy: origin, weight, storage migration, accounting and cross-consensus properties
adapters.reproduction_format: runtime hash/metadata, block state, extrinsics, events and storage diff
known_gaps: no bundled metadata parser/node
custom pallets and XCM versions require native specialization

adapters.enumeration_strategy: enumerate contracts, message handlers, cells, dictionaries and bounce paths
adapters.authority_model: message sender, signatures, seqno, wallet version and bounced-message provenance
adapters.state_model: cells, balances, dictionaries, messages and asynchronous transaction chains
adapters.trace_strategy: complete inbound/outbound message and transaction trace with cell/state diff
adapters.simulation_strategy: TVM emulator, sandbox or isolated testnet
adapters.property_strategy: message authentication, replay, bounce, gas/value conservation and async properties
adapters.reproduction_format: code/data cells, messages, fees, transaction chain and final state
known_gaps: no bundled TVM emulator
wallet and workchain semantics require version-specific validation

adapters.enumeration_strategy: enumerate contracts/ABI/bytecode, permissions, resources and deployment metadata
adapters.authority_model: account permissions, owner/active keys, caller and contract authority
adapters.state_model: TVM storage, TRX/TRC assets, energy/bandwidth and account permissions
adapters.trace_strategy: TRON-native transaction trace, events, resource usage and state diff
adapters.property_strategy: permission, resource, value conservation, replay and TVM-specific behavior
adapters.reproduction_format: network/block, contract version, transaction sequence, trace and state diff
known_gaps: no bundled TRON simulator
EVM similarities must not substitute for TVM evidence

adapters.enumeration_strategy: enumerate visible accounts/programs, methods, messages, events and state changes
adapters.authority_model: only authority visible in RPC/indexer evidence; unknown semantics remain explicit
adapters.simulation_strategy: none until a native adapter and safe environment are available
adapters.property_strategy: generic reachability and conservation hypotheses only
adapters.reproduction_format: RPC methods, network identity, messages/transactions, events and visible state diff
known_gaps: no native execution or authority semantics
cannot support complete chain-audit assurance
